name: Futago + Kango
source:
A hot midsummer day. Main character gets taken to Enoki Clinic by an accident. Lovely twin nurse sisters greet him and promise to take good care of onii-chan.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个炎热的盛夏日，主人公因意外被送往榎诊所。可爱的双胞胎护士姐妹迎接他，并承诺会好好照顾“哥哥”。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
